actualCompare.interpretation: Actual Profile Analyzer CompareSync + CompareDone results. Full frame ranges, one exact thread, inclusive Time, all depths, no name/parent/remove filters. Analyzer msMean divides marker total by frames containing that marker (ProfileAnalysis.SetupMarkers), not by all selected frames; both normalizations are exported. Differences are after minus before and valid only when hasDifference=true; absent markers are unavailable, not zero. Frame elapsed times include waits and capture boundaries. Inclusive marker times overlap; do not add them. One pair is diagnostic, not the three-repeat acceptance report.
